fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami-area civic and business matters, including calls for legislative reform ahead of the Florida legislature, criticism of public-utility telephone service and rates between Miami and Miami Beach, and discussion of harbor debris and cleanup. Coverage also addresses transportation policy and franchising through a continuing article on the city of Miami’s agreement with the Miami Beach Railway Company for motor bus operations, and reports on business efforts to reduce Florida East Coast Railway freight and passenger rates. The issue contains society/entertainment and sports-related notices and advertisements for local events and venues in Greater Miami.
